summary: Stale Revision: origin/master (5ce4e42) is not an ancestor of the reviewed SHA; merge-base is 50e889b, so the branch cannot fast-forward master. origin/master has 4 commits missing from this Revision: 5ce4e42 (pin GitHub Actions to full SHAs), dce9c66 (close timeout_ms bounds block), 773580e (exclude local .env), 15fe286 (opt-in Langfuse OTLP telemetry).
